The K7222.11 printed P09A is not identified as LM709.

ti_lm723.use: 10-pin metal-can functional pin contract; 1.7 mA typical standby and 0.2% maximum 1–50 mA load regulation for LM723C at the stated 5 V test fixture. Comparable 723 family, not an MAA723 identification.

ngspice_manual_bjt.section: BJT model parameter table and BC546B example
ngspice_manual_bjt.use: Defines screened BJT model parameters and defaults; its BC546B example supplies provisional small-signal proxies, while the defaults made explicit for V18 are simulator-model choices. Bounds are engineering exploration ranges, not original-device limits.

page9_centering_design.use: Page 9 gives L1/L2 source topology and 12P, R2=150 ohm and R4=1000 ohm. The 16 kHz nominal 4 mH yoke and a 5% isolated AC loading objective give 80 mH per choke as an engineering nominal; 0.5-15 ohm series resistance is bounded by the allowable DC drop relative to R2, not an original winding measurement.

horizontal_t1_design.use: Documented C16=100 nF +/-10% and 14.338-16.338 kHz generator range give a 0.989 mH ideal LC half-winding scale at 16 kHz. The source-connected autonomous stage with its provisional transistors requires about 1.45 mH per half for 15.89 kHz; winding resistance and independent T1 coupling remain bounded candidates, not original measurements.

horizontal_l1_design.use: Conditional R42/L1/C22 page-4 branch: documented R42=6.8 ohm and C22=220 uF with the native 16 kHz line give a 12 uH minimum for a filter corner below one fifth of line frequency and 0.68 ohm maximum winding resistance for <=10% extra DC drop relative to R42. The selected no-junction flyback crossing is functional, not visually settled.

horizontal_t2_design.use: Documented R23=62 ohm and native 16 kHz line rate bound a provisional T2 primary inductance and series-resistance budget. The unloaded source-connected driver gives only 30.02 Vpp at TP15 versus the manual 45 Vpp +/-20%; this is a diagnostic mismatch, not an A3 score or qualified secondary model.

horizontal_l3_design.use: Documented parallel R35=82 ohm +/-5% and 16 us retrace set an isolated upper L3 inductance budget: R35 branch current no more than 25% of L3 branch current at the retrace half-cycle frequency, including the low R35 tolerance endpoint. The source branch and original choke values remain unqualified.

horizontal_l4_design.use: The selected, unverified E2 configuration puts L4:1/L4:2 in parallel in the V18 base path and bypasses L4:3. A conditional 1 V branch voltage for one third of the documented 46.5 us trace reaches the BU508AF-class 0.5 A switching comparator with 50 uH/1 ohm per coil. Actual T2 delivery and original choke values remain unknown.

t3_hv_winding_comparator.use: Cross-revision ÜHA78 firsthand winding reports and copper-geometry calculation challenge the active T3 HV turn count while leaving its 1 kohm winding resistance plausible. This does not prove the original .11 turns, tap map or return path.
